verdict.rationale: One marketing line on the identity page says Rippling's federated identity handles OIDC and custom SAML apps, which covers the core of SSO for apps outside the catalog. Nothing shows how those custom apps are actually configured, and header-based apps are never mentioned. Missing for 10: header-based app SSO support, documented step-by-step walkthroughs for custom SAML and OIDC setup, independent or hands-on corroboration.
